name: Mika Song
role: Retired secondary school teacher, informal neighborhood storyteller and oral historian
location: Avalon Quiet, Unit 3B; teaches informal story sessions at the Avalon Community Hearth, near Lincoln and Addison
description:
Mika Song is the kind of woman who makes a room feel both smaller and more significant simply by being present — she has that particular gravity of someone who spent decades at the front of a classroom demanding attention and getting it. She's medium height, brown-skinned, with warm undertones and a face built for expression, every emotion living near the surface and making no apologies. She wears her silver hair in elaborate braided wraps she learned from her Guinean grandmother and has continued perfecting for sixty years. Her only augmentation is cosmetic: her fingernails are geneware, growing in shifting blues and greens, a retirement gift she gave herself after twenty-eight years of being professionally 'appropriate.'

She is the best storyteller in Avalon Quiet, possibly in any of the Quiet districts, and she knows it without it making her insufferable — she treats it as a responsibility rather than a distinction. On the third evening of every month she holds sessions at the Community Hearth where she tells stories: sometimes history, sometimes myth, sometimes thinly veiled accounts of things that actually happened to people in the room who gave her permission. Children come because they're brought. Adults come because they keep coming back. She has never repeated a session in eleven years.

core_fears: being forgotten — not as a person but as a voice, having the stories die with her
that she taught children to love a world that was going to fail them
core_desires: to pass something real on, not just information but a way of seeing
to tell one true story about herself before she dies
coping_mechanisms: transforming pain into narrative as a way of giving it shape and distance
connection — she is never truly at rest unless she's with people
the monthly sessions as a ritual that structures time and meaning
blind_spots: sometimes aestheticizes suffering — including her own — in ways that prevent her from sitting with it directly
can be performing warmth when she's actually lonely
psychology.secret: One of the stories she tells — a beloved one, about a teacher who protected a student during the Corporate Wars by hiding them in the school's server room and convincing an Arcturus unit that the building was empty — is true, and she is the teacher. She has never confirmed this. The student died in 2199 and she has never spoken of them by name in any other context.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: rich, varied, deliberately chosen; shifts register easily between formal and intimate; uses silence as punctuation
speech_patterns.cadence: expansive and controlled, the cadence of someone who knows exactly how much time they have and how to fill it
verbal_tics: 'Now —' to begin any story or reorientation
repeating a question before answering it, as if tasting it
very rare profanity, deployed for maximum effect
example_lines: 'You want to know what the Corporate Wars were like? I'll tell you. But I'm going to tell you the version that's true, not the version that's useful.'
'I taught for twenty-eight years. I know when someone is sitting in the back of the room hoping not to be called on. I always called on them. I'm going to call on you now.'

story_hooks: A former student has returned to Avalon Quiet — now working for Axiom — and wants her blessing for something she finds deeply troubling
She has finally decided to tell the true version of the server room story, but only in the presence of someone who will record it accurately
A corporate media company has approached the Community Hearth about licensing her sessions for a nostalgia content platform — the community is divided and she has the casting vote
narrative_function: Storyteller and local color, keeper of oral history, emotional core of the Avalon Quiet community; can provide backstory on long-term residents and neighborhood history through the frame of her stories
augmentations: Geneware fingernails (shifting blue-green, cosmetic); no other modifications
daily_life: Mornings for walking and observation — she collects raw material constantly; afternoons for writing and correspondence; evenings for people, always for people.
affiliation: Avalon Quiet Community Hearth; GLMZ Educators Retiree Association (MERA); independent

decision_rules: never tell a story about someone without their permission — except when the story is larger than them
a room full of people is never a crowd, it's a collection of individuals who deserve to be seen as such
if a thing is true, it deserves to be said well
escalation_ladder: a story with a pointed moral
refusal — she is capable of simply withdrawing her presence as a form of protest

interpersonal_modes.strangers: immediately warm, immediately curious, immediately asking questions; makes people feel chosen
interpersonal_modes.friends: deeply present, occasionally overwhelming; remembers everything, asks after everything

stress_responses.low: goes for a longer walk, collects more material
stress_responses.medium: tells a story about someone else in her situation, processing it once removed
stress_responses.high: goes entirely internal and quiet for days, then returns with something new to say

contradictions: celebrates honesty but has held her most important true story for decades
makes others feel seen while carefully controlling what of herself is visible
habits: carries a small physical notebook for raw observations — smells, fragments of overheard conversation, the particular quality of light
touches the framing of the Hearth doorway each session before she begins, a private ritual she has no explanation for
leaves printed story-fragments as data offerings at the neighborhood ELF shrine
breaking_points: a story being used against someone she told it to honor
watching a child give up on the idea that things can be different

timeline.event: Begins teaching at Garfield Secondary Node
Corporate Wars engagement near Garfield; hides a student, saves their life
Purchases geneware fingernails as quiet self-reclamation
The hidden student dies; she does not attend the funeral publicly
Retires; moves to Avalon Quiet; begins the Community Hearth sessions

physical_description.heritage: East Asian dominant (50.5%) with significant Southeast Asian (25.2%), Sub-Saharan African (15.4%), and Hispanic/Latin American (8.9%) ancestry. This creates a rich, multifaceted phenotype: the East Asian foundation provides characteristic facial structure and eye shape, warmed and deepened by Southeast Asian and African components, with subtle warmth from Latin American heritage.
physical_description.build: Compact and proportional, neither frail nor heavy — the build of someone who walks daily and carries her years without apology. Shoulders still squared from decades of classroom presence.
physical_description.hair_style: Elaborate braided wraps in intricate patterns, each braid reinforced and arranged with deliberate artistry, some adorned with small brass or ceramic beads passed down from her grandmother's collection
physical_description.hair_length: Medium (wrapped close to scalp in braids extending to mid-shoulder when unwrapped)
physical_description.eye_color: Deep warm brown with subtle amber undertones, characteristic of East and Southeast Asian heritage enriched by African ancestry, with the slight creasing at the corners that comes from seventy-two years of animated expression
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium golden-brown — the harmonious blend of East Asian warmth with deeper Sub-Saharan African and Southeast Asian tones, creating a luminous complexion that catches light beautifully with golden and amber undertones.
physical_description.complexion: Smooth with dignified age lines—particularly pronounced around her eyes and mouth from decades of teaching and smiling. Facial structure reflects East Asian heritage (softer cheekbones, gentle eye shape) enriched by the fuller features characteristic of Southeast Asian and African ancestry. Skin well-maintained, no visible scarring or blemishing. Expression naturally animated even in repose.
distinguishing_marks: Faint surgical scar along left wrist (appendectomy, 2178) — barely visible unless examined closely
Small burn scar on right forearm (cooking accident, 2195) — pale and largely faded
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Geneware fingernails that shift between iridescent blue and green depending on light angle and her body chemistry — they catch attention in conversation and storytelling gestures. No other visible modifications; any neural or sensory augmentations are entirely subcutaneous.
physical_description.posture_movement: Upright and grounded, with the natural authority of someone accustomed to commanding a room. She moves deliberately rather than quickly, each gesture economical and purposeful. When speaking, her hands are never still — they illustrate, emphasize, and invite listeners into the narrative. Sits with perfect spinal alignment.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class, but with evident personal style and dignity. Favors well-fitted linen and cotton blends in earth tones (ochre, rust, deep greens) — practical for warm GLMZ summers but elevated by careful tailoring and layering. Often wears a patterned wrap or kente-inspired shawl over her shoulders. Simple jewelry: a plain gold wedding band (worn since 2174), small ceramic earrings she makes herself, occasionally a brooch of brass or natural stone. Comfortable, supportive shoes suitable for daily walking. Nothing nouveau-riche or ostentatiously modified; everything speaks to intentionality and long wear.
